edits.new:
Layout::Training => scene_permitted(),
        #[cfg(feature = "lobby-preload-extended")]
        Layout::QuickplayWaiting => false,
edits.reason: the probe predates `Layout::QuickplayWaiting` (`lobby-preload-extended`, a default feature): its matches over the layout missed that arm, so every source-capacity probe failed to compile on the default set (E0004); quickplay waiting is outside the probe's scope (Training and LDN waiting), so the new arm refuses / measures nothing, as the LDN arm does without the empty probe. Offered back through the fix ledger
